{{nihongo|'''Hosokawa Shrine'''|細川神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

===Enshrined deities===
*Hosokawa Mizu-Ōkami
*{{ill|Isotakeru-no-Mikoto|lt=Isotakeru-no-Kami|Q10881556|qid=Q10881556|qid=Q10881556|lt=Isotakeru-no-Mikoto}}
*:The {{ill|jinjameisaichou|ja|神社明細帳|qid=Q11590704}} says “deity unknown”; ''Osaka Prefecture Historic Sites / Scenic Places / Natural Monuments'' gives Hosokawa Suijin, {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}}, and {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|ar|سوغاوارا نو ميتشيزانه|br|Sugawara no Michizane|ckb|سوگاوارا نۆ میچیزانێ|de|Sugawara no Michizane|es|Sugawara no Michizane|fa|سوگاوارا نو میچی‌زانه|fi|Sugawara no Michizane|fr|Sugawara no Michizane|id|Sugawara no Michizane|it|Sugawara no Michizane|ja|菅原道真|kk|Сугавара но Митидзане|ko|스가와라노 미치자네|la|Sugawara no Michizane|ms|Sugawara no Michizane|nl|Sugawara no Michizane|nn|Sugawara no Michizane|pl|Michizane Sugawara|pt|Sugawara no Michizane|ru|Сугавара-но Митидзанэ|sh|Sugawara no Michizane|sv|Sugawara no Michizane|th|สึกาวาระ โนะ มิจิซาเนะ|tr|Sugawara no Michizane|uk|Суґавара но Мітідзане|zh|菅原道真|zh_classical|菅原道真|zh_min_nan|Sugawara no Mitizane|qid=Q382005}}.

===History===
The founding date is unclear, but ''Osaka-fu Zenshi'' says it predates the Tenpyō era (729-748). From the medieval period onward, its location (identification site) was unknown, but ''{{ill|Settsu Meisho Zue|ja|摂津名所図会|qid=Q11498549}}'' records: “Hosokawa Shrine is on Jionji-yama in Yoshida Village. It is an Engishiki shrine, now called {{ill|Vaiśravaṇa|Q866315|qid=Q866315}}, and is the inner sanctuary of Kuan-ji.” Until {{ill|Namikawa Seisho|Q6563872|qid=Q6563872}} identified it as a Shikinaisha in the {{ill|Kyōhō|de|Kyōhō|es|Kyōhō|fa|کیوهو|fr|Ère Kyōhō|ja|享保|ko|교호|ru|Кёхо|simple|Kyōhō|sr|Кјохо|sv|Kyōhō|tr|Kyōhō|zh|享保|qid=Q1145048}} era (1716-1735), it had been transmitted as the inner sanctuary of {{ill|Kyuan-ji Temple|Q11369269|qid=Q11369269|lt=Kuan-ji}}.
* Ranked as {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}} in Meiji 5.
* On September 19, Meiji 40, merged Tenmangū of Fushio, Susa-no-o of Mon-dō in Nakagawara, Hachiman Shrine of Furu-e Shimogaito, and Atago Shrine of Kubo in Higashiyama.
* Designated as shinsen-heihaku offering shrine in December Meiji 41<ref>Eitarō Ikuzawa, ''Shikinaisha Chōsa Hōkoku Vol.5'' (1977) {{全国書誌番号|78005760}}</ref>.

=== Access ===
*From {{ill|Ikeda Station (Osaka)|Q866156|qid=Q866156|lt=Ikeda Station}} on the {{ill|Hankyu Takarazuka Main Line|Q3832859|qid=Q3832859}}, take Hankyu Bus toward Kuan-ji, get off at Higashiyama, about 10 minutes on foot.
